planName: New York Managed Long Term Care (partial capitation)
population: Adults 21+ who need community-based long-term care for more than 120 days, mostly dual eligibles
notes: Partial capitation MLTC covers long-term care only. Medical care is Medicare or Medicaid fee-for-service. MAP and PACE products are not covered by this template.
